name: Silver and Golden Mark of War spell descriptions name Runes of Descension (#12608, #12609)
contract: Silver Mark of War (1201002, spell 413116) and Golden Mark of War (1201003, spell 413117) still read
'Runes of Ascension' in the client's Spell.dbc. Server Spell.dbc already reads 'Runes of Descension',
but AscensionCompat only streams Spell.dbc descriptions via SMSG_PATCH_SPELL (opcode 2346) when the
spell is listed in coa_client_spell_description. Both rows must stream with 'Runes of Descension' and
without 'Ascension'. Row 500639 (Runeshroud) is the positive control that the stream is captured.
Rendered client text is outside the harness.
